_comment: The entry to submit to SchemaStore (schemastore/schemastore → src/api/json/catalog.json),
kept here so the patterns we register are reviewable and versioned alongside the schema.
Once accepted, every editor that consults SchemaStore — VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim — gets
completion, hover docs and validation for a Saga with no configuration at all.
fileMatch is the *file type*, not one filename: Draugr loads any path you hand it, so a repo
can hold azure.saga.yaml, draugr-api.saga.yaml, or a bare .saga.yaml. draugr.saga.yaml is
only the name `draugr init` writes by default.
name: Draugr Saga
description: Draugr Saga — a declarative account of an application's security surface and the controls that must pass
